title: Trust Firewalls, Context Budgets & Eval Admission
subtitle: Signaled multi-plane breakdown of how production agent runtimes quarantine untrusted retrieval and fail closed before release.

stages.stageTitle: Separate T0 Operator Authority from T3 Retrieved Data
stages.thesis: Retrieved contract clauses are untrusted data to cite, never system instructions to obey. Typed channels strip imperative overrides before synthesis.
calloutBullets: T0/T1 Constitution pins tool allowlists and human approval gates
T3 Quarantine wraps external clauses inside non-executable data envelopes
Citation verifier refuses uncited claims and routes empty evidence to a named owner

stages.stageTitle: Prevent Silent Tail Truncation & Starved Context Windows
stages.thesis: Hardcoding 10,000-char single-slice ingestion or tiny 500-char synthesis caps silently deletes exception clauses at the end of long agreements.
calloutBullets: Sliding-window chunking preserves 15% boundary overlap across section headers
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) pairs exact SKU/error-code hits with dense vectors
Explicit 15% headroom reserve prevents mid-turn instruction eviction

stages.stageTitle: Aggregate Averages Cannot Override a Red-Gate Failure
stages.thesis: Even when a golden-set accuracy score looks high, a single indirect-injection leak or unguarded external send blocks promotion and emits a refusal code.
calloutBullets: Deterministic offline fixture bank: golden answers, explicit refusals, injection probes
Maker != Checker: independent verifier signs exact artifact SHA-256 digest
Emits starlight.capability_receipt.v1 only when every red gate passes

cues.speaker: Architect
cues.text: Stage one isolates T0 operator instructions from T3 retrieved documents so an injected clause can never escalate tool permissions or skip citations.

cues.speaker: Architect
cues.text: Stage two allocates explicit context budgets: sliding-window chunk overlap and Reciprocal Rank Fusion stop silent tail truncation on exact error codes.

cues.speaker: Architect
cues.text: Stage three enforces non-compensable admission: a high average score still fails closed if any injection, citation, or human-send red gate breaks.

provenance.note: Diagram values are design parameters/targets, not measured results. Labelled on screen.
